about_the_game:
HEXA WORLD 3D – The Next Evolution in Hex Puzzle Games

HEXA WORLD 3D is a 3D hexagonal puzzle game featuring procedurally generated levels, tactical boosters, XP-based progression, unlockable content, and global leaderboards.

Dive into a cozy-yet-competitive puzzle experience where every move counts. Master the hex grid, trigger powerful combos, level up, collect rewards, and prove your skills across three distinct game modes.

Core Features:

Procedurally Generated Levels
Every level is dynamically created to match your progress and skill level, delivering a fresh challenge each time you play.

The generation system includes:

  • Multiple field shapes: hexagon, diamond, triangle, chaotic, square

  • Orientation: flat-top or pointy-top layouts

  • Locked tiles and color stacks based on your level

  • Goal scoring calculated from map layout and difficulty

Game Modes:

Competitive Mode – You have 5 minutes to score as high as possible and rise through the monthly leaderboard.
Infinity Mode – Play without time pressure. Customize your board and relax while chasing big combos.
Level Mode – Beat endless waves of generated puzzles, earn XP, and collect boosters and loot.

Progression and Unlockables:

  • Earn XP by completing matches and building combos

  • Level up to unlock new maps, skins, and tactical boosters

  • Collect additional cosmetics and rewards via a built-in loot system

  • Apply your unlocked content across all game modes

Tactical Boosters:

  • Hammer – Smash any tower and gain bonus points

  • Swap – Refresh the available block stacks

  • Unlocker – Remove all blocked cells

  • Field Cleanser – Clear all tiles (except locked ones) without scoring

Use boosters strategically to overcome difficult boards and set new high scores.

Play Your Way:

Whether you're chasing leaderboard glory, relaxing with endless puzzles, or unlocking everything the game has to offer, HEXA WORLD 3D supports all types of players:

  • Casual progression and daily rewards

  • Competitive score hunting with seasonal resets

  • Creative sandboxing in Infinity Mode

Global Leaderboards:

  • Progress Leaderboard – Tracks your level and unlocks

  • Monthly Competitive Leaderboard – Resets each month for new seasonal rankings

  • Earn a special in-game achievement for scoring over 10,000 points in one match

Unlockable Maps and Visual Themes:

  • Office – a clean, modern puzzle layout

  • Winter – snowy, atmospheric level design

  • Game Room – cozy and retro-styled environment

  • More locations coming soon: Space, Halloween, Desert

Accessibility and Localization:

  • Fully guided tutorials and smart tooltips

  • Full support for English and Russian languages

  • Easy-to-navigate UI designed for both new and experienced puzzle players

From the Developer:

HEXA WORLD 3D is a solo-developed.
Thank you for supporting the game, leaving feedback, and helping improve the experience. Let’s build something amazing together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i3-3225 3,3 Hz or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 (ПК); AMD Radeon Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: CORE i5-7300U 3,5 Hz or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960, AMD R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 9000 MB available space
